base: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: STAR CANNON level 0-0, ONE isolated transparent sprite, fantasy sci-fi tower for top-down 2D tower defense Celestial Void. Polished hand-painted cartoon 3/4 overhead orthographic view, matching ornate ivory and gold celestial ruins. A SIMPLE, modest ivory cannon with slim gold trim, a small glowing purple-blue cosmic core, a star-shaped muzzle rim, ONE barrel aimed diagonally upper-right, resting on a low simple circular ivory plinth. Base version restrained and clearly low level, no giant wings, no crown, no excess aura, no text. The circular ground contact is horizontally centered at 50% of canvas width and vertically at 80% of canvas height. Whole tower silhouette fits x=20%-80%, y=18%-83%, with ample transparent margin. Fixed orthographic pose, crisp shapes readable at 100 pixels. Soft baked shading, restrained glow, true transparent background, no floor, no environment, no drop shadow outside the base, no UI, no labels, no black backdrop. Square canvas. Preserve this exact base placement for all future variants.
